scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,catalog,sample,flappy -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:catalog" "npm run dev:game" "npm run dev:flappy"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m pytest
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:workspaces
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy app
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bolb23/game-client-sdk && npm run build --workspace @game-platform/catalog-web && npm run build --workspace @game-platform/sample-game && npm run build --workspace @game-platform/flappy-mike
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli seed
